name: Tenstorrent Wormhole Series (corsix.org)
description: Peter Cawley's eight-part reverse-engineering series on Wormhole: physical layout and disabled rows, NoC propagation delay, Ethernet, the insides of a Tensix tile, the vector instruction set, bits of the matmul unit and a closing reference. The companion repo is a functional description of the vector instructions.
author: Peter Cawley
